blocks.text: Biochemistry is the branch of science that deals with the study of chemical substances found in living organisms and the reactions they undergo. The biological compounds are complex molecules with the same types of functional groups those found in simple organic compounds, such as alcohol, amine, aldehyde, ketone, carboxylic acid, ester, and amide groups.

This chapter focuses on the essential biomolecules such as carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, and nucleic acids, featuring their structures, functions, and roles in cellular processes. In addition to these biomolecules, the roles of minerals and enzymes in biochemical processes will also be discussed.
